steps.title: Stream Choice (Class 10 Completion)
steps.detail: Choose Science stream with Physics, Mathematics, and optionally Chemistry/Computer Science in Class 11.

steps.title: Class 12 Boards & Engineering Entrances
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 with minimum 60% aggregate in PCM. Prepare for national/state engineering entrances such as JEE Main or state CETs.

steps.title: Undergraduate Degree (B.Tech / B.E. / B.Sc CS / BCA)
steps.detail: Enroll in a 4-year B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or 3-year BCA/B.Sc CS. Master Data Structures, Algorithms, Operating Systems, and DBMS.

steps.title: Software Development Projects & Open Source
steps.detail: Build full-stack applications, contribute to open source on GitHub, and practice competitive programming on LeetCode/HackerRank.

steps.title: Industry Software Internship
steps.detail: Complete a 3-6 month software engineering internship during 3rd/4th year, working with version control (Git) and Agile sprints.

steps.title: Entry-Level SDE Placement & Specialisation
steps.detail: Clear technical and system design interviews to land a role as Junior Software Engineer / SDE-1, specializing in backend, frontend, or distributed systems.

steps.title: Science Stream with Mathematics
steps.detail: Select Science stream with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) or Computer Science after Class 10.

steps.title: Engineering or IT Degree
steps.detail: Pursue B.Tech CSE, IT, or BCA. Gain strong fundamentals in computer networking, OS internals, and scripting (Python, Bash).

steps.title: Linux Systems Administration & Containerisation
steps.detail: Master Linux CLI, shell scripting, containerisation with Docker, and orchestration using Kubernetes (CKA curriculum).

steps.title: Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure as Code
steps.detail: Build automation pipelines using GitHub Actions/GitLab CI and deploy Infrastructure as Code with Terraform on AWS or Azure.

steps.title: Cloud / DevOps Associate Certification
steps.detail: Obtain recognized credentials such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Linux Foundation CKA to validate cloud deployment expertise.

steps.title: DevOps / SRE Role
steps.detail: Join an engineering organization as an Associate DevOps Engineer or SRE, managing zero-downtime deployments and telemetry monitoring.

steps.title: Class 10 to Higher Secondary with Mathematics
steps.detail: Complete Class 12 with a strong foundation in Mathematics, Statistics, and Computer Science.

steps.title: STEM Bachelor's Degree
steps.detail: Complete B.Tech in CS/AI, B.Sc in Statistics/Mathematics, or BS in Data Science. Focus on linear algebra, calculus, and probability.

steps.title: Data Engineering & Modeling Mastery
steps.detail: Master SQL, Python (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn), feature engineering, exploratory data analysis, and predictive modeling.

steps.title: Kaggle Competitions & Portfolio Projects
steps.detail: Build real-world ML projects, publish notebooks on Kaggle, build computer vision / NLP models, and deploy models via FastAPI.

steps.title: Data Science Internship / Research Apprenticeship
steps.detail: Complete a 3-6 month corporate internship solving business analytics, predictive pricing, or recommendation system problems.

steps.title: Junior Data Scientist / ML Engineer Role
steps.detail: Secure a position as an Associate Data Scientist, deploying production models and deriving actionable insights from big data.

steps.title: Higher Secondary (PCM or Computer Science)
steps.detail: Complete Class 12 with Science (Mathematics/Physics) or vocational IT subjects.

steps.title: Degree in Computer Science or Cybersecurity
steps.detail: Enroll in B.Tech Computer Science, B.Sc Cybersecurity, or BCA with specialization in Network Security.

steps.title: Networking & Security Core Competencies
steps.detail: Study TCP/IP, OSI model, cryptographic protocols, packet analysis with Wireshark, Linux security, and OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.

steps.title: Industry Certifications (CompTIA Security+ / CEH)
steps.detail: Clear foundational security certifications such as CompTIA Security+ or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) to validate threat detection skills.

steps.title: Hands-on SOC Lab Training & CTF Challenges
steps.detail: Participate in capture-the-flag (CTF) challenges on TryHackMe/HackTheBox and gain experience with SIEM tools (Splunk, Wazuh).

steps.title: SOC Analyst / Cybersecurity Professional Role
steps.detail: Join a Security Operations Center (SOC) as a Tier-1 Analyst monitoring real-time incidents, log analysis, and vulnerability mitigation.

steps.title: Class 10 to Science Stream (PCB)
steps.detail: Opt for Science with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) in Class 11 and Class 12.

steps.title: Class 12 Boards (Minimum 50% in PCB)
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 with at least 50% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (40% for reserved categories).

steps.title: NEET-UG Entrance Examination via NTA
steps.detail: Appear for and qualify the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET-UG) conducted annually by the National Testing Agency (NTA).

steps.title: MBBS Degree (4.5 Years Academic Course)
steps.detail: Secure admission via MCC/State counselling to complete 4.5 years of medical curriculum including anatomy, pharmacology, pathology, and clinical rotations.

steps.title: Compulsory Rotatory Internship (1 Year)
steps.detail: Complete a mandatory 1-year paid clinical internship rotating through medicine, surgery, obstetrics/gynecology, and community health.

steps.title: NMC Registration & Licensure
steps.detail: Register with the National Medical Commission (NMC) or State Medical Council to receive a permanent medical practice registration number.

steps.title: Medical Practice or Post-Graduate Specialisation (MD/MS)
steps.detail: Begin practice as a General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) or appear for NEET-PG/NExT for MD/MS specialization in cardiology, neurology, pediatrics, etc.

steps.title: Science Stream with Biology (PCB)
steps.detail: Choose Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) in Class 11-12 following Class 10.

steps.title: NEET-UG Examination
steps.detail: Qualify the NEET-UG examination conducted by NTA with eligible percentile for dental college counselling.

steps.title: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) Course
steps.detail: Complete the 4-year BDS curriculum covering dental anatomy, oral pathology, prosthodontics, conservative dentistry, and orthodontics.

steps.title: 1-Year Paid Dental Internship
steps.detail: Complete 12 months of hands-on clinical rotational internship in a recognized dental hospital handling extractions, fillings, and RCTs.

steps.title: State Dental Council Registration
steps.detail: Register with the Dental Council of India (DCI) / State Dental Council to obtain the license to practice dental medicine.

steps.title: Clinical Practice or Master of Dental Surgery (MDS)
steps.detail: Set up private dental clinic, join a hospital, or clear NEET-MDS to specialize in orthodontics, oral surgery, or pediatric dentistry.

steps.title: Higher Secondary with PCB
steps.detail: Complete Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English with minimum 50% marks.

steps.title: NEET-UG / State Veterinary Entrance
steps.detail: Qualify NEET-UG for Veterinary Council of India (VCI) 15% quota or state-specific veterinary entrance exams.

steps.title: B.V.Sc & A.H. Degree Program
steps.detail: Complete the 4.5-year Bachelor of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry degree program accredited by VCI.

steps.title: Compulsory Veterinary Internship (1 Year)
steps.detail: Undertake practical internship at veterinary colleges, livestock farms, dairy plants, and wildlife/zoo centers.

steps.title: Veterinary Council of India (VCI) Registration
steps.detail: Mandatory registration with State Veterinary Council and the Veterinary Council of India to practice veterinary medicine legally.

steps.title: Professional Practice / Government Veterinary Officer
steps.detail: Practice in companion animal clinics, livestock farms, animal welfare organizations, or join State Animal Husbandry Department as Veterinary Officer.

steps.title: Science Stream in Class 12 (PCB / PCM)
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology or Mathematics with at least 50% marks.

steps.title: Pharmacy Entrance Examination
steps.detail: Appear for state pharmacy entrance tests (MHT-CET, WBJEE, KCET, etc.) or CUET-UG for central pharmacy programs.

steps.title: B.Pharm Degree Course (4 Years)
steps.detail: Complete 4-year Bachelor of Pharmacy program accredited by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), covering pharmaceutics, medicinal chemistry, and pharmacology.

steps.title: Hospital / Industrial Pharmacy Training
steps.detail: Undergo mandatory practical training in hospital pharmacies or pharmaceutical manufacturing units.

steps.title: PCI Registered Pharmacist Licensure
steps.detail: Register with the State Pharmacy Council under the Pharmacy Act to obtain official Registered Pharmacist (R.Pharm) certificate.

steps.title: Career: Clinical, Retail, or Pharma R&D
steps.detail: Work as a Hospital Pharmacist, Retail Chemist, Quality Assurance Analyst in pharma companies, or appear for Drug Inspector exams.

steps.title: Science Stream with Biology (Class 12)
steps.detail: Complete Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English with minimum 45% aggregate marks.

steps.title: B.Sc Nursing Entrance Exam
steps.detail: Appear for AIIMS B.Sc Nursing, state entrance exams, or university-specific tests (NEET-UG scores used by several institutions).

steps.title: B.Sc Nursing Degree Program (4 Years)
steps.detail: Complete the 4-year degree recognized by the Indian Nursing Council (INC) comprising medical-surgical nursing, pediatrics, and community health.

steps.title: Clinical Hospital Rotations
steps.detail: Gain extensive hands-on experience in ICU, emergency wards, maternity units, and operation theaters.

steps.title: State Nursing Council Registration (RN & RM)
steps.detail: Register with the State Nursing Council to earn the Registered Nurse (RN) and Registered Midwife (RM) license.

steps.title: Hospital Nursing Officer / NORCET Exam
steps.detail: Join leading hospital networks or qualify AIIMS NORCET examination for Central Government Nursing Officer positions.

steps.title: Higher Secondary in Science (PCB)
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology with minimum 50% marks.

steps.title: Paramedical / BPT Entrance Test
steps.detail: Appear for university or state-level paramedical entrance examinations (IPU CET, NEET scores in some states, etc.).

steps.title: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - 4.5 Years
steps.detail: Complete the 4-year academic coursework covering anatomy, physiology, biomechanics, exercise therapy, and electrotherapy.

steps.title: 6-Month Mandatory Clinical Internship
steps.detail: Undergo 6 months of supervised clinical training in orthopedics, neurology, cardiopulmonary, and sports medicine wards.

steps.title: Allied Healthcare Council Registration
steps.detail: Register under the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP) or state physiotherapy council.

steps.title: Clinical Practice or Sports Specialisation (MPT)
steps.detail: Work in hospitals, sports clinics, rehabilitation centers, or pursue Master of Physiotherapy (MPT) in sports or neuro-rehab.

steps.title: Class 10 Completion & Register with ICAI
steps.detail: Provisional registration with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) after passing Class 10.

steps.title: Pass Class 12 & CA Foundation Exam
steps.detail: Complete Class 12 (any stream, Commerce preferred) and clear the 4-paper CA Foundation examination.

steps.title: CA Intermediate Course (Both Groups)
steps.detail: Enroll in CA Intermediate, study advanced accounting, corporate law, taxation, and auditing; clear Group 1 and Group 2.

steps.title: ICITSS Soft Skills & IT Training
steps.detail: Complete mandatory Integrated Course on Information Technology and Soft Skills (ICITSS) before commencing practical training.

steps.title: Practical Articleship Training (2 Years)
steps.detail: Undergo 2 years of unbroken practical training under a practicing Chartered Accountant, handling statutory audits, taxation, and compliance.

steps.title: CA Final Examination
steps.detail: Clear the comprehensive CA Final examination (Financial Reporting, Strategic Financial Management, Advanced Auditing).

steps.title: ICAI Membership & Practice / Corporate Leadership
steps.detail: Obtain Certificate of Practice (COP) for independent auditing or take up senior finance/CFO roles in multinational corporations.

steps.title: Class 12 Completion (Any Stream)
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 in Commerce, Arts, or Science from a recognized education board.

steps.title: CSEET Entrance Exam (ICSI)
steps.detail: Clear the CS Executive Entrance Test (CSEET) conducted by the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI).

steps.title: CS Executive Program
steps.detail: Complete the CS Executive stage covering Company Law, Securities Laws, Economic Laws, and Tax Laws.

steps.title: CS Professional Program
steps.detail: Qualify the CS Professional examination focusing on Governance, Risk Management, Corporate Restructuring, and Drafting.

steps.title: Practical Training (21 Months EDP)
steps.detail: Complete 21 months of practical training under a Practicing Company Secretary (PCS) or approved corporate house.

steps.title: ICSI Associate Membership (ACS)
steps.detail: Receive Associate Company Secretary (ACS) credential to advise corporate boards on regulatory compliance and governance.

steps.title: Class 10 & 12 Completion
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 from any recognized board to become eligible for CMA Foundation examination.

steps.title: CMA Foundation Exam via ICMAI
steps.detail: Register with the Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI) and clear the CMA Foundation exam.

steps.title: CMA Intermediate Course
steps.detail: Pass both groups of CMA Intermediate covering Cost Accounting, Financial Management, Direct & Indirect Taxation, and Operations.

steps.title: Practical Training (15 Months)
steps.detail: Undergo mandatory 15 months of practical training in cost analysis, budgeting, and inventory valuation in a manufacturing or corporate setup.

steps.title: CMA Final Examination
steps.detail: Clear CMA Final exam focusing on Strategic Cost Management, Corporate Financial Reporting, and Strategic Performance Management.

steps.title: ICMAI Membership & Practice / Industrial Role
steps.detail: Receive Associate Membership (ACMA) to conduct statutory cost audits, pricing decisions, and supply-chain cost optimization.

steps.title: Class 12 with Advanced Mathematics
steps.detail: Excel in Class 12 with Mathematics or Statistics, building deep fluency in calculus, probability, and algebra.

steps.title: ACET Examination via Institute of Actuaries of India
steps.detail: Appear for and pass the Actuarial Common Entrance Test (ACET) to gain student membership of the IAI.

steps.title: Bachelor's Degree in Maths / Statistics / Actuarial Science
steps.detail: Pursue B.Sc in Mathematics, Statistics, or Actuarial Science while simultaneously preparing for professional actuarial papers.

steps.title: Clear Core Principles Papers (CS, CM, CB Series)
steps.detail: Clear foundational actuarial exams: Actuarial Statistics (CS1, CS2), Actuarial Mathematics (CM1, CM2), and Business (CB1, CB2).

steps.title: Actuarial Internship / Junior Analyst Experience
steps.detail: Work with life insurance, general insurance, or reinsurance firms building stochastic loss models and reserving methodologies.

steps.title: Fellowship (FIAI) & Chief Actuary Certification
steps.detail: Clear specialist applications (SA series) and peer review modules to earn Fellowship (FIAI), authorising valuation of insurance solvency.

steps.title: Class 12 in Any Discipline
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 with Commerce, Science, or Humanities with strong quantitative and communication skills.

steps.title: Undergraduate Graduation Degree
steps.detail: Complete any Bachelor's degree (B.Com, BBA, B.Tech, B.A., B.Sc) with minimum 55-60% marks as required for banking examinations.

steps.title: Competitive Exam Prep (Aptitude, Reasoning, Banking Awareness)
steps.detail: Prepare for quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, English comprehension, general financial awareness, and computer knowledge.

steps.title: IBPS PO / SBI PO Competitive Examinations
steps.detail: Appear for and qualify Preliminary exam, Main exam, and Descriptive Paper conducted by IBPS or State Bank of India.

steps.title: Psychometric Assessment & Group Interview
steps.detail: Clear the personality interview and group exercise conducted by public sector bank selection boards.

steps.title: 2-Year Probationary Training & Branch Placement
steps.detail: Complete 2 years of probation covering retail banking, credit appraisal, treasury operations, and foreign exchange.

steps.title: Class 12 with Economics and Mathematics
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 with strong grades in Economics, Mathematics, and Statistics.

steps.title: B.A. / B.Sc in Economics
steps.detail: Complete a 3 or 4-year undergraduate degree in Economics from recognized universities (DSE, St. Stephen's, Loyola, Christ, etc.).

steps.title: Econometric & Statistical Tools
steps.detail: Learn advanced econometric modeling, regression analysis, and tools such as R, Stata, Python, and EViews.

steps.title: Master's Degree (M.A. / M.Sc in Economics)
steps.detail: Complete a postgraduate degree in Economics, Quantitative Economics, or Financial Economics (via CUET-PG or institute entrances).

steps.title: Indian Economic Service (IES) / Corporate Research
steps.detail: Appear for the Indian Economic Service (IES) exam conducted by UPSC, or join central bank / investment bank research teams.

steps.title: Senior Economic Advisor / Policy Researcher
steps.detail: Lead macroeconomic forecasts, monetary policy analysis, development policy design, or trade impact assessments.

steps.title: Class 10 to Higher Secondary (Any Stream)
steps.detail: Complete Class 12 in Humanities, Commerce, or Science with minimum 45% marks.

steps.title: CLAT / AILET Law Entrance Examination
steps.detail: Appear for the Common Law Admission Test (CLAT) or AILET for admission to National Law Universities (NLUs).

steps.title: 5-Year Integrated B.A. LL.B / BBA LL.B Degree
steps.detail: Complete 5 years of legal education covering Constitutional Law, Criminal Law (BNS), Civil Procedure, Torts, and Corporate Law.

steps.title: Court Mooting & Chamber Internships
steps.detail: Participate in national moot court competitions and undertake mandatory internships with senior advocates, law firms, and legal aid clinics.

steps.title: State Bar Council Enrolment
steps.detail: Enroll as an Advocate with the respective State Bar Council to obtain provisional permission to practice law.

steps.title: All India Bar Examination (AIBE)
steps.detail: Clear the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) conducted by the Bar Council of India to receive Certificate of Practice (COP).

steps.title: Independent Litigation / Corporate Legal Counsel
steps.detail: Argue matters in district courts and High Courts, or join corporate legal teams managing M&A transactions, contracts, and IP rights.

steps.title: Class 10 to Higher Secondary (Any Stream)
steps.detail: Complete Class 12 in any stream, cultivating habits of reading national daily newspapers and understanding civic issues.

steps.title: Undergraduate Bachelor's Degree (Any Field)
steps.detail: Complete any Bachelor's degree (Humanities, Engineering, Commerce, Medicine). Deepen understanding of polity, history, geography, and economics.

steps.title: UPSC Civil Services Preliminary Examination
steps.detail: Appear for and clear UPSC CSE Prelims: General Studies Paper I and Civil Services Aptitude Test (CSAT Paper II).

steps.title: UPSC Civil Services Main Examination (9 Papers)
steps.detail: Write 9 descriptive subjective papers covering Essay, GS I-IV, Language papers, and chosen Optional Subject.

steps.title: Personality Test / Interview at Dholpur House
steps.detail: Clear the comprehensive UPSC interview evaluating mental alertness, leadership, moral integrity, and social balance.

steps.title: LBSNAA Foundation Course & Academy Training
steps.detail: Undergo professional administrative training at Lal Bahadur Shastri National Academy of Administration (LBSNAA), Mussoorie.

steps.title: Cadre Allotment & Sub-Divisional Magistrate Posting
steps.detail: Begin field postings as Assistant Collector / SDM managing law and order, land revenue administration, and public welfare schemes.

steps.title: Higher Secondary Completion (Class 12)
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 in any stream with interest in sociology, psychology, and public health.

steps.title: Bachelor of Social Work (BSW) / BA Social Sciences
steps.detail: Enroll in a 3-year BSW program focusing on social policy, human behavior, human rights, and social research methods.

steps.title: Field Practicum & Rural Community Camps
steps.detail: Complete mandatory concurrent fieldwork placements with grassroots NGOs, slum communities, and tribal welfare missions.

steps.title: Master of Social Work (MSW)
steps.detail: Appear for CUET-PG or institute entrances (e.g. TISS NET / CUET) to specialize in Mental Health, Child & Family, or Community Development.

steps.title: Specialized Field Interventions & Research
steps.detail: Conduct fieldwork with hospital psychiatric units, women shelter homes, or child protection committees.

steps.title: NGO Program Officer / CSR Lead / Medical Social Worker
steps.detail: Lead development interventions in UN agencies, national NGOs, Corporate Social Responsibility foundations, or hospitals.

steps.title: Class 10 to Higher Secondary (Any Stream)
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 in any stream. Develop sketching, observation, and creative problem-solving skills.

steps.title: Design Entrance Exams (UCEED / NID DAT / NIFT)
steps.detail: Appear for national design entrance tests like UCEED (conducted by IIT Bombay) or NID Design Aptitude Test.

steps.title: Bachelor of Design (B.Des) Degree
steps.detail: Enroll in a 4-year B.Des program in Interaction Design, Product Design, or Communication Design.

steps.title: UX Research & Prototyping Mastery
steps.detail: Master Figma, user interviews, information architecture, wireframing, usability testing, and design systems.

steps.title: Case Study Portfolio Development
steps.detail: Build a portfolio with 3-4 end-to-end design case studies showcasing problem statement, iteration, metrics, and high-fidelity prototypes.

steps.title: Product Designer / UI/UX Role
steps.detail: Join tech companies, digital product agencies, or startups as Product Designer crafting user experiences.

steps.title: Class 12 in Any Stream
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 from any recognized board with interest in textiles, illustration, and cultural trends.

steps.title: NIFT Entrance Examination (CAT & GAT)
steps.detail: Appear for the National Institute of Fashion Technology entrance exam: Creative Ability Test (CAT) and General Ability Test (GAT).

steps.title: Bachelor of Fashion Design (B.Des Fashion)
steps.detail: Complete a 4-year degree in Fashion Design covering pattern making, draping, fabric science, garment construction, and CAD.

steps.title: Textile Mill & Export House Internship
steps.detail: Undergo an intensive 8-10 week industry internship in garment manufacturing or with an established couture fashion designer.

steps.title: Graduation Collection Showcase
steps.detail: Design, manufacture, and present a cohesive 5-look collection at the annual college runway graduation exhibition.

steps.title: Fashion House Designer / Independent Label
steps.detail: Work with fashion export brands, luxury retail houses, or launch an independent sustainable apparel label.

steps.title: Class 12 Completion (Maths or Arts)
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 with interest in computer graphics, 3D spatial thinking, storytelling, and digital arts.

steps.title: B.Des Animation / B.Sc Gaming & VFX Degree
steps.detail: Complete a 3-4 year degree program in Animation, Game Design, or Computer Science with Game Development.

steps.title: 3D Modeling & Animation Fundamentals
steps.detail: Master Blender/Maya for polygonal modeling, texturing, rigging, character skinning, and lighting.

steps.title: Game Engine Programming (Unity / Unreal)
steps.detail: Learn C# scripting in Unity or C++/Blueprints in Unreal Engine 5, managing physics, collision, and game loops.

steps.title: Playable Game Demo / Animation Showreel
steps.detail: Publish a playable game prototype on itch.io or create a 60-second character animation reel on ArtStation.

steps.title: Game Studio / VFX House Placement
steps.detail: Secure a position as Gameplay Programmer, Junior 3D Animator, or Technical Artist at gaming studios or VFX production houses.

steps.title: Class 12 in Any Discipline
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 with Humanities, Commerce, or Science, maintaining keen interest in current affairs, writing, and fact-checking.

steps.title: Bachelor of Journalism and Mass Communication (BJMC)
steps.detail: Complete a 3-year BJMC / BA Journalism degree covering news reporting, media ethics, broadcast production, and digital media.

steps.title: IIMC / University Postgraduate Diploma Entrance
steps.detail: Appear for CUET-PG or Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC) entrance for postgraduate diploma in Journalism.

steps.title: Newsroom / Media House Internship
steps.detail: Undertake practical newsroom internships covering beat reporting, press conferences, photojournalism, and copy editing.

steps.title: Digital Investigative Portfolio
steps.detail: Publish articles, investigative video reports, or data journalism stories covering civic, business, or political issues.

steps.title: Staff Reporter / Broadcast Correspondent Role
steps.detail: Join leading news organizations, digital publishers, or national daily newspapers as a Staff Correspondent.

steps.title: Class 10 to Science Stream (PCM)
steps.detail: Opt for Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) in Class 11-12 with strong problem-solving orientation.

steps.title: Engineering Entrances (JEE Main / State CETs)
steps.detail: Appear for JEE Main, JEE Advanced, or state-level engineering entrances for admission to NITs, IITs, and government engineering colleges.

steps.title: B.Tech / B.E. in Core Engineering Branch
steps.detail: Complete a 4-year degree in Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering accredited by AICTE.

steps.title: CAD Modeling & Simulation Proficiency
steps.detail: Master industry-standard CAD/CAE tools: AutoCAD, SolidWorks, CATIA, MATLAB, or STAAD.Pro for structural/circuit design.

steps.title: Industrial Manufacturing / Site Internship
steps.detail: Complete a 6-8 week on-site plant or construction internship (L&T, Tata Motors, BHEL, or state PWD departments).

steps.title: GATE Exam / PSU Placement / Core Engineering Role
steps.detail: Clear the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) for PSU recruitment (NTPC, ONGC, IOCL) or join top infrastructure/manufacturing firms.

steps.title: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 with at least 50% aggregate marks in PCM as mandated by the Council of Architecture (COA).

steps.title: NATA / JEE Main Paper 2 Entrance Exam
steps.detail: Qualify the National Aptitude Test in Architecture (NATA) conducted by COA or JEE Main Paper 2 for SPA/NIT admissions.

steps.title: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch) - 5 Years
steps.detail: Complete the 5-year B.Arch course recognized by COA covering architectural design studios, building materials, structures, and history.

steps.title: Architectural Office Internship (Practical Training)
steps.detail: Complete a mandatory semester-long architectural internship working on live site measurements, drafting, and client briefs.

steps.title: Council of Architecture (COA) Registration
steps.detail: Register with the Council of Architecture (COA) under the Architects Act 1972 to legally hold the title 'Architect' in India.

steps.title: Architectural Practice / Urban Planning
steps.detail: Establish an independent architectural studio or work with top planning and sustainable architecture consultancies.

steps.title: Pass Class 10 (Secondary School)
steps.detail: Pass Class 10 with Science and Mathematics from any recognized state or central board.

steps.title: Enroll in ITI or Polytechnic Diploma
steps.detail: Join a 2-year ITI trade (Electrician, Fitter, Machinist, Wireman) or 3-year Polytechnic Diploma in Mechanical/Electrical/Civil.

steps.title: Workshop Hands-on Trade Training
steps.detail: Complete hands-on vocational training: blueprints reading, precision measuring instruments, lathe machines, and electrical safety standards.

steps.title: All India Trade Test (AITT) via NCVT
steps.detail: Pass the All India Trade Test (AITT) to earn the National Trade Certificate (NTC) issued by the National Council for Vocational Training.

steps.title: National Apprenticeship Training (NATS/NAPS)
steps.detail: Complete 1 year of paid industrial apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act in Indian Railways, PSUs, or manufacturing plants.

steps.title: Certified Trade Technician / Lateral Entry to B.Tech
steps.detail: Work as Certified Maintenance Technician or Junior Engineer, or utilize lateral entry into 2nd year B.Tech for degree advancement.

steps.title: Class 12 Boards in Chosen Subject Stream
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 with at least 50% marks in the discipline you aspire to teach (Science, Humanities, or Commerce).

steps.title: NCET Entrance for 4-Year Integrated ITEP
steps.detail: Appear for the National Common Entrance Test (NCET) conducted by NTA for admission to 4-year Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP).

steps.title: B.Ed / Integrated ITEP Course Completion
steps.detail: Complete B.Ed or 4-year ITEP (B.A. B.Ed / B.Sc B.Ed) accredited by NCTE covering pedagogy, child psychology, and micro-teaching.

steps.title: School Internship & Practice Teaching
steps.detail: Complete 16-20 weeks of supervised practice teaching in schools, designing lesson plans and evaluating student outcomes.

steps.title: Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET / State TET)
steps.detail: Clear CTET Paper I (Primary) or Paper II (Elementary/Secondary) conducted by CBSE or respective State TET.

steps.title: TGT/PGT Appointment (KVS, NVS, State Schools)
steps.detail: Appear for recruitment examinations (KVS, NVS, DSSSB) to secure appointment as Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) or Post Graduate Teacher (PGT).

steps.title: Undergraduate Bachelor's Degree in Core Discipline
steps.detail: Complete a 3 or 4-year Bachelor's degree (B.A., B.Sc, B.Com, or B.Tech) with academic distinction.

steps.title: Postgraduate Master's Degree (Minimum 55%)
steps.detail: Complete Master's degree (M.A., M.Sc, M.Com, or M.Tech) in the specialized discipline with at least 55% marks.

steps.title: Qualify UGC-NET / CSIR-NET / SLET for Assistant Professor
steps.detail: Appear for and qualify UGC-NET or CSIR-NET (or state-level SLET) to establish eligibility for Assistant Professor and JRF scholarship.

steps.title: Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) Research
steps.detail: Complete doctoral research (Ph.D.) with original thesis submission, publishing research papers in peer-reviewed Scopus/UGC-CARE journals.

steps.title: Teaching Assistantship & Conference Presentations
steps.detail: Deliver undergraduate lectures, present papers at national and international conferences, and mentor students.

steps.title: Assistant Professor Appointment & Tenured Faculty
steps.detail: Participate in university recruitment interviews under UGC regulations for appointment as Assistant Professor.

steps.title: Class 12 in Any Stream (Psychology Elective Helpful)
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 with good grades in Humanities or Science.

steps.title: B.A. / B.Sc in Psychology
steps.detail: Complete a 3-year undergraduate degree in Psychology covering cognitive, developmental, social, and abnormal psychology.

steps.title: M.A. / M.Sc in Psychology or Clinical Psychology
steps.detail: Complete a 2-year Master's degree in Psychology focusing on psychometrics, therapeutic techniques, and diagnostic assessments.

steps.title: M.Phil / Professional Diploma in Clinical Psychology
steps.detail: Complete a 2-year hospital-based clinical training program recognized by the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI).

steps.title: RCI Registration as Licensed Clinical Psychologist
steps.detail: Obtain official registration with the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) to practice psychotherapy legally in India.

steps.title: Independent Clinical Practice / Hospital Consultant
steps.detail: Provide clinical evaluations, cognitive behavioral therapy, and counseling services in hospitals, schools, or private clinics.

steps.title: Science Stream in Class 12 (PCM / PCB)
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 with at least 60% in Science subjects, cultivating scientific curiosity and experimental methodology.

steps.title: Bachelor's in Science (BS / B.Sc / B.Tech)
steps.detail: Enroll in premiere institutions (IISER, IISc, IITs, or central universities) for an integrated or standalone BS/B.Sc.

steps.title: Master's Degree (M.Sc / MS / M.Tech)
steps.detail: Complete Master's degree with dissertation work in specialized physics, chemistry, biotechnology, or material science.

steps.title: National Fellowship Qualifying (CSIR-UGC JRF / GATE)
steps.detail: Clear CSIR-UGC NET JRF, GATE, or JEST with top percentile to secure Junior Research Fellowship funding.

steps.title: Ph.D. Research & International Publications
steps.detail: Conduct 4-5 years of rigorous laboratory/computational research, authoring first-author papers in high-impact scientific journals.

steps.title: Scientist Position in National Labs (CSIR/DRDO/ISRO)
steps.detail: Join as Scientist-C/D at CSIR, DRDO, ISRO, or corporate R&D laboratories leading breakthrough innovation and patents.

steps.title: Class 12 in Science (PCB / PCM / Agriculture)
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 with at least 50% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Maths/Agriculture.

steps.title: CUET (ICAR-UG) Entrance Exam
steps.detail: Appear for the CUET (ICAR-UG) conducted by NTA for admission to agricultural universities across India.

steps.title: B.Sc (Hons) Agriculture Degree (4 Years)
steps.detail: Complete 4-year degree accredited by ICAR covering agronomy, genetics, plant pathology, soil science, and agricultural economics.

steps.title: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE)
steps.detail: Complete a semester-long village stay program (RAWE) working directly with farming communities on crop health and agro-clinics.

steps.title: M.Sc & ICAR-AIEEA-PG Exam
steps.detail: Qualify ICAR-AIEEA-PG to pursue Master's in specialized fields such as Plant Breeding, Seed Technology, or Soil Chemistry.

steps.title: Agricultural Research Service (ARS / NET) Exam
steps.detail: Clear the Agricultural Research Service (ARS) examination conducted by ASRB for Scientist postings at ICAR institutes.

steps.title: Class 12 Completion (Any Stream)
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 in Commerce, Science, or Arts with at least 50% marks.

steps.title: Bachelor's Degree (BBA / B.Com / B.Tech / B.A.)
steps.detail: Complete any undergraduate Bachelor's degree with strong academic record, leadership initiatives, and business society activities.

steps.title: CAT / XAT / GMAT MBA Entrance Exams
steps.detail: Appear for the Common Admission Test (CAT) conducted by IIMs or XAT/GMAT for admission to top business schools.

steps.title: MBA / PGDM Program at Top B-School
steps.detail: Complete 2-year full-time MBA studying Marketing, Finance, Operations, Strategy, and Human Resources.

steps.title: Corporate Summer Internship (8-10 Weeks)
steps.detail: Work on an intensive summer internship project with FMCG, consulting, investment banking, or tech firms.

steps.title: Management Associate / Strategy Lead
steps.detail: Join multinational corporations or management consultancies leading business unit growth, operations, and team strategy.

steps.title: Class 12 in Any Stream with English
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 from any recognized board with English as a compulsory subject.

steps.title: NCHMCT JEE Entrance Examination
steps.detail: Appear for the National Council for Hotel Management Joint Entrance Examination (NCHMCT JEE) conducted by NTA.

steps.title: B.Sc in Hospitality & Hotel Administration (3 Years)
steps.detail: Complete the 3-year degree at an affiliated Institute of Hotel Management (IHM) covering Front Office, F&B Service, Culinary Arts, and Housekeeping.

steps.title: Industrial Training in 5-Star Hotel (20 Weeks)
steps.detail: Complete 20 weeks of rigorous rotational industrial exposure in all core departments of a premier 5-star hotel brand.

steps.title: Management Training (MT) / Operations Executive
steps.detail: Join flagship Management Trainee programs (Taj, Marriott, Oberoi OCLD, ITC) through campus recruitment.

steps.title: General Manager / Luxury Hospitality Director
steps.detail: Advance to Department Head and General Manager overseeing hotel revenue, luxury guest experience, and multinational operations.

steps.title: Class 12 Boards (PCM for Air Force/Navy, Any Stream for Army)
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 with Physics and Mathematics for Air Force / Navy, or any stream for Indian Army NDA entry.

steps.title: NDA / CDS Written Examination via UPSC
steps.detail: Qualify the National Defence Academy (NDA) after Class 12 or Combined Defence Services (CDS) exam after Graduation.

steps.title: 5-Day Services Selection Board (SSB) Interview
steps.detail: Clear the comprehensive 5-day SSB interview including psychological testing, group testing officer (GTO) tasks, and personal interview.

steps.title: Special Military Medical Board Examination
steps.detail: Pass strict physical standards, vision checks, and comprehensive medical examination at designated military command hospitals.

steps.title: Military Academy Training (NDA / IMA / INA / AFA)
steps.detail: Complete 3 years of rigorous academic and physical training at NDA Khadakwasla followed by 1 year at IMA Dehradun / INA / AFA.

steps.title: Presidential Commission as Lieutenant / Flying Officer / Sub-Lieutenant
steps.detail: Receive the President's Commission upon passing out parade, commanding platoons and operational military units.

steps.title: Class 12 with Physics & Mathematics
steps.detail: Pass Class 12 with Physics and Mathematics (minimum 50% aggregate) or equivalent through NIOS.

steps.title: DGCA Class 2 & Class 1 Medical Assessment
steps.detail: Undergo and pass Class 2 and Class 1 medical examinations conducted by DGCA-approved medical examiners and IAF centres.

steps.title: DGCA Theory Ground School Examinations
steps.detail: Clear DGCA theory examinations in Air Navigation, Aviation Meteorology, Air Regulations, Technical General, and RTR (Aero).

steps.title: Flying Training School (200 Flying Hours)
steps.detail: Enroll in a DGCA-approved Flying Training Organization (FTO) and complete 200 hours of flight time (solo, cross-country, night, instrument).

steps.title: Commercial Pilot Licence (CPL) Issuance
steps.detail: Receive the Commercial Pilot Licence (CPL) issued by the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) with Multi-Engine Rating.

steps.title: Aircraft Type Rating (A320 / B737)
steps.detail: Complete aircraft Type Rating on commercial passenger jets (Airbus A320 or Boeing 737) at an approved training organization (ATO).

steps.title: Airline First Officer / Captain
steps.detail: Join a commercial passenger or cargo airline as First Officer, advancing to Commander / Captain after fulfilling required flight command hours.

steps.title: School Level Sports Training & District Representation
steps.detail: Develop physical conditioning and competitive excellence in a chosen sport representing school and district teams.

steps.title: Class 12 Boards & State Championship Medals
steps.detail: Complete Class 12 while competing at State and National School Games federations (SGFI).

steps.title: Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed) / Sports Science
steps.detail: Enroll in a 3-4 year degree in Physical Education, Sports Coaching, or Kinesiology from sports universities (LNIPE, NSU).

steps.title: National Institute of Sports (NIS) Diploma in Coaching
steps.detail: Clear the entrance test for 1-year Diploma in Sports Coaching at Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports (NSNIS), Patiala.

steps.title: National / International Representation & Medals
steps.detail: Participate in National Games, Khelo India University Games, or international championships representing India.

steps.title: Professional Sports Coach / Sports Officer Recruitment
steps.detail: Secure direct appointments under sports quota in Indian Railways, Armed Forces, or join SAI / elite academies as Certified Coach.
